import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        
        if (n == 1) {
            int x = scanner.nextInt();
            System.out.println(x);
            return;
        }
        
        int[] s = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            s[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        
        Arrays.sort(s);
        System.out.println(s[(n - 1) / 2]);
    }
}
